EmailTemplate.subject: [Webinar] Get ahead of NACHA's Account Validation Rule
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[COHEAO WEBINAR] What you need to know: NACHA Account Validation Rule How to verify consumer account information With the deadline for the Account Validation Rule quickly approaching, organizations initiating consumer ACH debits via the internet or mobile devices will need to verify consumer account information for the first payment. Join us for an informative webinar on Thursday, February 25th, 2-3 PM ET.
David King, CTO at Flywire, will share everything you need to know and how you can prepare for the NACHA Account Validation Rule alongside additional changing regulations that lie ahead.
